about: A jet's cockpit as chapter 1 describes it (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §2): per panel its controls, each by its node in the cockpit's control table (shared/extra/models/cockpit3d/<cockpit>.json): label as on the panel, name (the words behind the initials), positions (optional; their count is checked against the control table, which gives the count when they are left out), does (the real jet, from the panel's source), sim (what the sim does with it and what stops working while it is off; modern-iaf/docs/cockpit.md §5.2; none: the layout says whether the control works a system, from the control table). abbreviations: every abbreviation the manual uses, with its full name: the Abbreviations appendix, and the brackets at an abbreviation's first use in a chapter's steps. short: everyday shortenings, listed in the appendix only. words: plain words the panels write in capitals. tools/manuals.py stops the build on a capital token that is in none of the three.

abbreviations.ACM: Air combat mode: the radar's dogfight patterns
abbreviations.CNI: Communication, navigation, identification: the DED's main page
abbreviations.DBS: Doppler beam sharpening: a sharper ground map patch
abbreviations.DTE: Data transfer equipment: the data cartridge
abbreviations.INR: Inertial rates: the pod holds its direction
abbreviations.RPM: Revolutions per minute, shown in percent
abbreviations.BMS: Falcon BMS, a flight simulator whose forum is a source

short.MIL: Military power, full power without the afterburner

controls.label: MAL & IND LTS
controls.name: Malfunction and indicator lights test
controls.does: Pressed, lights every malfunction and indicator light of the cockpit, to find a failed lamp.
controls.sim: Every lamp lights while it is held.

controls.label: FIRE & OHEAT DETECT
controls.name: Fire and overheat detection test
controls.does: Pressed, tests the engine's fire and overheat detection loops: the ENG FIRE and OVERHEAT lights come on.
controls.sim: The ENG FIRE and OVERHEAT lights come on while it is pressed.

controls.label: OXY QTY
controls.name: Oxygen quantity test
controls.does: Held, drives the liquid oxygen quantity indicator down to check it and the OXY LOW caution.

controls.label: EPU/GEN
controls.name: Emergency power unit and generator test
controls.does: Held on the ground, checks the EPU's generator and the FLCS's power sources without running the EPU.
controls.sim: Lights the FLCS PWR lights while held.

controls.label: PROBE HEAT
controls.name: Probe heat
controls.does: Heats the air data probes against ice. TEST checks the heaters' monitor: the PROBE HEAT caution flashes.
controls.sim: The caution flashes at TEST. Icing and the heaters are not modelled.

controls.label: FLCS PWR TEST
controls.name: Flight control system power test
controls.does: Held at TEST on the ground, checks the power sources of the flight control system; the FLCS PWR lights show them.
controls.sim: The FLCS PWR lights are on while the switch is held. No power source is tested.

controls.label: FLCS PWR
controls.name: Flight control system power lights
controls.does: Four lights, A to D: each of the flight control computer's four branches has good power during the test.
controls.sim: On while FLCS PWR TEST or EPU/GEN is held.

controls.label: TEST
controls.name: Test switch (inboard panel)
controls.does: A test switch of the inboard panel beside the TEST panel (inferred from the cockpit model: the flight manual's figure names no such switch).

controls.label: DIGITAL BACKUP
controls.name: Digital backup (DBU)
controls.does: Puts the flight control computer on its backup software; the DBU ON light shows it.
controls.sim: The DBU ON lights come on. The flight control laws stay the same.

controls.label: LE FLAPS
controls.name: Leading-edge flaps
controls.does: AUTO: the flight control system moves the leading-edge flaps with speed and angle of attack. LOCK holds them where they are.
controls.sim: Not modelled: the flaps always follow the flight control system.

controls.label: ALT FLAPS
controls.name: Alternate flaps
controls.does: NORM: the trailing-edge flaps come down with the landing gear handle. EXTEND lowers them whatever the handle's position.

controls.label: BIT
controls.name: Flight control system built-in test
controls.does: Runs the flight control system's self test on the ground; the RUN light is on while it runs, the FAIL light shows a fault.
controls.sim: The RUN lights come on at BIT. No test runs and none fails.

controls.label: RUN
controls.name: Built-in test running
controls.does: On while the flight control system's self test runs.
controls.sim: On while the BIT switch is at BIT.

controls.label: FAIL
controls.name: Built-in test failed
controls.does: The self test found a fault.

controls.label: Status lights
controls.name: Flight control status lights
controls.does: A block of four status lights on the cockpit model's panel (inferred: the model draws them, the Block 50 flight manual's figure has none here).

controls.label: Panel lights
controls.name: Panel legend lights
controls.does: Three legend lights of the cockpit model beside the LE FLAPS switch (inferred).

controls.label: MASTER
controls.name: Master fuel switch
controls.does: Opens the main fuel shut-off valve; OFF cuts the fuel to the engine. A guard holds it at MASTER.

controls.label: TANK INERTING
controls.name: Tank inerting
controls.does: Lowers the tanks' pressure and puts Halon into them, to keep a hit tank from exploding.

controls.label: ENG FEED
controls.name: Engine feed
controls.does: Chooses the tank pumps that feed the engine: all of them at NORM; the aft or the forward tanks only, to correct a fuel imbalance; none at OFF.
controls.sim: Not modelled: the knob turns, the fuel feeds the same at every position.

controls.label: AIR REFUEL
controls.name: Air refuelling door
controls.does: Opens the refuelling receptacle's door and lowers the tanks' pressure; the flight control system changes to its take-off and landing gains.
controls.sim: OPEN lets the AR status light work; the door, the tanks and the gains do not change.

controls.label: MASTER
controls.name: Exterior lights master
controls.does: Lets the exterior lights come on; off, all of them are dark.
controls.sim: The exterior lights need it on, and the generator on line.

controls.label: ANTI COLLISION
controls.name: Anti-collision light
controls.does: Turns on the flashing white light on the fin.
controls.sim: The strobe follows the switch.

controls.label: POSITION FLASH / STEADY
controls.name: Position lights flash
controls.does: Makes the position lights flash or burn steadily.
controls.sim: FLASH blinks the wing and tail lights.

controls.label: WING/TAIL
controls.name: Wing and tail position lights
controls.does: Sets the position lights on the wings and the tail bright or dim.
controls.sim: The wing, intake and tail lights follow the switch.

controls.label: FUSELAGE
controls.name: Fuselage position lights
controls.does: Sets the fuselage's position lights.
controls.sim: The fuselage lights follow the switch.

controls.label: FORM
controls.name: Formation lights
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the formation lights, the strips on the fuselage and fin.
controls.sim: The strips follow the knob; with WING/TAIL at OFF they also light the wingtips.

controls.label: AERIAL REFUELING
controls.name: Air refuelling light
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the light that shows the receptacle to the tanker.
controls.sim: The light follows the knob.

controls.label: MAIN PWR
controls.name: Main power
controls.does: Connects the jet's electrical buses to their sources: at BATT the aircraft battery, at MAIN PWR the battery and the generators.
controls.sim: OFF: no power; the displays, the HUD and the lamps are dark, and the INS loses its alignment. BATT: the lamps, the engine gauges and the INS's alignment only. The displays need MAIN PWR and a running engine.

controls.label: CAUTION RESET
controls.name: Electrical caution reset
controls.does: Resets the electrical system's cautions and the ELEC SYS caution light.
controls.sim: Acknowledges the ELEC SYS caution, so MASTER CAUTION goes out.

controls.label: MAIN GEN
controls.name: Main generator light
controls.does: The main generator is off the buses.
controls.sim: On while the jet is on the battery.

controls.label: STBY GEN
controls.name: Standby generator light
controls.does: The standby generator is off the buses.
controls.sim: On while the jet is on the battery.

controls.label: FLCS PMG
controls.name: Flight control permanent magnet generator light
controls.does: The flight control system's own generator gives no power.
controls.sim: On until the JFS turns the engine.

controls.label: EPU GEN
controls.name: EPU generator light
controls.does: The EPU runs and its generator gives no power.

controls.label: EPU PMG
controls.name: EPU permanent magnet generator light
controls.does: The EPU runs and its second generator gives no power.

controls.label: ACFT BATT TO FLCS
controls.name: Battery to flight controls light
controls.does: The aircraft battery feeds the flight control system.
controls.sim: On while the engine turns below 44 % RPM in a start or a run-down.

controls.label: ACFT BATT FLCS RLY
controls.name: Flight control relay light
controls.does: A relay that connects the flight control system to the battery is not closed.
controls.sim: On until the JFS turns the engine.

controls.label: ACFT BATT FAIL
controls.name: Battery fail light
controls.does: The aircraft battery has failed or its voltage is low.

controls.label: EPU
controls.name: Emergency power unit
controls.does: The EPU gives emergency electrical and hydraulic power when the engine's generators or pumps stop. NORM lets it start by itself, ON runs it, OFF keeps it from running on the ground. A guard holds the switch at NORM.
controls.sim: Not modelled: the sim has no EPU. The guard and the switch move.

controls.label: Guard
controls.name: EPU switch guard
controls.does: Holds the EPU switch at NORM; lifted, it lets the switch go to ON or OFF.

controls.label: EPU run light
controls.name: EPU run light
controls.does: Green while the EPU turns fast enough to give power.

controls.label: HYDRAZN
controls.name: Hydrazine light
controls.does: The EPU burns its hydrazine fuel.

controls.label: AIR
controls.name: Air light
controls.does: The EPU runs on engine bleed air.

controls.label: TEST
controls.name: Video recorder test
controls.does: Tests the airborne video tape recorder's lights.
controls.sim: Lights the two AVTR lights.

controls.label: AVTR
controls.name: Video recorder lights
controls.does: The recorder runs; its tape is near its end.
controls.sim: On while the TEST button is in.

controls.label: 1 to 4
controls.name: ECM band buttons
controls.does: Lit buttons that turn on the jamming pod's bands.

controls.label: 5, FRM, SPL
controls.name: ECM band and mode buttons
controls.does: Lit buttons for the fifth band and the pod's formation and special modes.

controls.label: JFS
controls.name: Jet fuel starter
controls.does: Starts the JFS, the small turbine that cranks the engine. START 1 uses one of the two brake and JFS accumulators, START 2 both. The JFS cuts out by itself once the engine runs.
controls.sim: START 1 and START 2 start the engine alike. The switch springs back to OFF at about 52 % RPM. Without electrical power it does nothing.

controls.label: RUN
controls.name: JFS run light
controls.does: Green while the jet fuel starter runs at speed.
controls.sim: On from the JFS's spool-up until the JFS switch goes back to OFF.

controls.label: MAX POWER
controls.name: Maximum power
controls.does: Lets the engine run above its normal limits for a short time in war.

controls.label: AB RESET
controls.name: Afterburner reset
controls.does: AB RESET clears an afterburner fault of the engine control; ENG DATA records the engine's data.

controls.label: MANUAL PITCH
controls.name: Manual pitch override
controls.does: Held at OVRD, removes the flight control system's limit on the stabilators so the pilot can rock the jet out of a deep stall.

controls.label: COMM 1
controls.name: Radio 1 (UHF) volume
controls.does: Turns radio 1 on and sets its volume.

controls.label: COMM 2
controls.name: Radio 2 (VHF) volume
controls.does: Turns radio 2 on and sets its volume.

controls.label: MSL
controls.name: Missile tone volume
controls.does: Sets the volume of the missile seeker's tone.
controls.sim: Sets the seeker tone's volume.

controls.label: THREAT
controls.name: Threat tone volume
controls.does: Sets the volume of the radar warning receiver's tones.
controls.sim: Sets the warning tones' volume.

controls.label: INTERCOM
controls.name: Intercom volume
controls.does: Sets the volume of everything in the headset.

controls.label: TACAN
controls.name: TACAN volume
controls.does: Sets the volume of the TACAN station's identifier.

controls.label: ILS
controls.name: ILS volume
controls.does: Turns the instrument landing system on and sets the volume of its identifier.

controls.label: Throttle
controls.name: Throttle
controls.does: Sets the engine's thrust. OFF cuts the fuel; a detent holds IDLE; past MIL the afterburner lights.
controls.sim: Moves with the throttle keys and a throttle lever; the pointer does not move it.

controls.label: RWR
controls.name: Radar warning receiver source
controls.does: Lets the dispenser act on the radar warning receiver's threats.

controls.label: JMR
controls.name: Jammer source
controls.does: Lets the dispenser work together with the jammer.

controls.label: MWS
controls.name: Missile warning system source
controls.does: Lets the dispenser act on the missile warning system's alarms.

controls.label: JETT
controls.name: Jettison
controls.does: Throws out all the flares at once.
controls.sim: Releases every flare.

controls.label: O1
controls.name: Other 1
controls.does: Arms the first spare expendable type.

controls.label: O2
controls.name: Other 2
controls.does: Arms the second spare expendable type.

controls.label: CH
controls.name: Chaff
controls.does: Arms the chaff.

controls.label: FL
controls.name: Flare
controls.does: Arms the flares.

controls.label: MODE
controls.name: Dispenser mode
controls.does: Sets how the dispenser releases: held ready (STBY), by the pilot's switch (MAN), or with the sensors' consent or by itself.

controls.label: HMCS SYMBOLOGY INT
controls.name: Helmet-mounted cueing system brightness
controls.does: Turns the helmet display on and sets its brightness.

controls.label: ALT GEAR
controls.name: Alternate gear extension
controls.does: Pulled, lowers the landing gear with stored air when the hydraulics cannot.

controls.label: Landing gear handle
controls.name: Landing gear handle
controls.does: DN lowers the landing gear, UP raises it.

controls.label: Handle light
controls.name: Gear handle warning light
controls.does: Red while the gear is moving or does not agree with the handle.
controls.sim: On while a leg is not where the handle is.

controls.label: Nose gear light
controls.name: Nose gear down light
controls.does: Green: the nose gear is down and locked.
controls.sim: On with the leg down.

controls.label: Left gear light
controls.name: Left gear down light
controls.does: Green: the left main gear is down and locked.
controls.sim: On with the leg down.

controls.label: Right gear light
controls.name: Right gear down light
controls.does: Green: the right main gear is down and locked.
controls.sim: On with the leg down.

controls.label: HOOK
controls.name: Arresting hook
controls.does: Lowers the hook that catches a runway's arresting cable.

controls.label: PARKING BRAKE / ANTI-SKID
controls.name: Parking brake and anti-skid
controls.does: Holds the wheel brakes on while parked; ANTI-SKID keeps the wheels from locking.

controls.label: LANDING TAXI LIGHTS
controls.name: Landing and taxi lights
controls.does: Turns on the taxi light or the landing light on the nose gear.

controls.label: HORN SILENCER
controls.name: Gear warning horn silencer
controls.does: Silences the horn that warns of a low, slow jet with the gear up.

controls.label: STORES CONFIG
controls.name: Stores configuration
controls.does: Tells the flight control system what the jet carries: CAT III limits the angle of attack and the roll rate for heavy loads.
controls.sim: CAT III applies the heavy-load limits.

controls.label: GND JETT ENABLE
controls.name: Ground jettison enable
controls.does: Lets stores be jettisoned with the jet on its wheels.

controls.label: EMER STORES JETTISON
controls.name: Emergency stores jettison
controls.does: Held, drops every jettisonable store at once.
controls.sim: Drops the tanks and the air-to-ground stores.

controls.label: MASTER ARM
controls.name: Master arm
controls.does: MASTER ARM lets weapons leave the jet. OFF holds them. SIMULATE shows the weapon symbols for practice and holds the weapons.

controls.label: LASER ARM
controls.name: Laser arm
controls.does: Lets the targeting pod's laser fire.
controls.sim: The pod's laser fires only with the switch at LASER ARM.

controls.label: ALT REL
controls.name: Alternate release
controls.does: A second weapon release button, the same as the stick's.

controls.label: RF
controls.name: Radio frequency emissions
controls.does: QUIET lowers the jet's radio emissions, SILENT stops them.

controls.label: ECM
controls.name: ECM enabled light
controls.does: The jamming pod is allowed to transmit.
controls.sim: On while the jamming pod is on.

controls.label: ROLL
controls.name: Autopilot roll mode
controls.does: Chooses what the autopilot holds in roll: the selected heading, the attitude, or the steering to the steerpoint.

controls.label: PITCH
controls.name: Autopilot pitch mode
controls.does: Engages the autopilot: it holds the altitude or the pitch attitude.

controls.label: ADV MODE
controls.name: Advanced mode
controls.does: Engages terrain following; its two halves light ACTIVE and STBY.

controls.label: MASTER CAUTION
controls.name: Master caution light and reset
controls.does: Lights when any caution light comes on. Pressed, it goes out and is ready for the next caution; the caution's own light stays.

controls.label: TF FAIL
controls.name: Terrain following fail light
controls.does: The terrain following system has failed.

controls.label: Spare lights
controls.name: Spare warning lights
controls.does: Three positions without a legend.

controls.label: IFF IDENT
controls.name: IFF identification
controls.does: Sends the identification pulse a controller asks for.

controls.label: F-ACK
controls.name: Fault acknowledge
controls.does: Shows the pilot fault list and acknowledges its faults.

controls.label: Threat warning display
controls.name: Threat warning display
controls.does: Shows each radar that looks at the jet as a symbol at its bearing.

controls.label: INT
controls.name: Display intensity
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the threat warning display.

controls.label: HANDOFF
controls.name: Handoff
controls.does: A lit button: chooses which threat's tone the headset plays.

controls.label: MISSILE LAUNCH
controls.name: Missile launch light
controls.does: Flashes red when a radar guides a missile at the jet.
controls.sim: Flashes at a launch.

controls.label: PRIORITY
controls.name: Priority mode
controls.does: PRIORITY shows only the five most dangerous threats.

controls.label: UNKNOWN
controls.name: Unknown threats
controls.does: Shows the radars the system cannot name.

controls.label: TGT SEP
controls.name: Target separate
controls.does: Held, spreads symbols that lie on top of each other.

controls.label: SYS TEST
controls.name: System test
controls.does: A lit button: runs the receiver's self test.
controls.sim: On during the display's test.

controls.label: HUD
controls.name: Head-up display
controls.does: Shows the flight path, the speed, the altitude, the steering and the weapon symbols on a glass in the line of sight.

controls.label: AOA indexer, top
controls.name: Angle of attack high
controls.does: A red chevron: the angle of attack is above the approach value, the jet is slow.

controls.label: AOA indexer, middle
controls.name: Angle of attack on speed
controls.does: A green circle: the angle of attack is right for the approach.

controls.label: AOA indexer, bottom
controls.name: Angle of attack low
controls.does: A yellow chevron: the angle of attack is below the approach value, the jet is fast.

controls.label: RDY
controls.name: Air refuelling ready
controls.does: The refuelling door is open and the jet is ready for the boom.

controls.label: AR/NWS
controls.name: Air refuelling contact / nosewheel steering
controls.does: In the air: the boom is latched. On the ground: the nosewheel steering is on.
controls.sim: On with the jet on its wheels.

controls.label: DISC
controls.name: Air refuelling disconnect
controls.does: The boom has let go.

controls.label: COM 1
controls.name: Radio 1 override
controls.does: Shows radio 1's page on the DED.

controls.label: COM 2
controls.name: Radio 2 override
controls.does: Shows radio 2's page on the DED.

controls.label: IFF
controls.name: IFF override
controls.does: Shows the IFF page on the DED.

controls.label: LIST
controls.name: List
controls.does: Shows the list of the DED's pages.

controls.label: A-A
controls.name: Air-to-air master mode
controls.does: Puts the avionics in the air-to-air master mode; pressed again, back to navigation.

controls.label: A-G
controls.name: Air-to-ground master mode
controls.does: Puts the avionics in the air-to-ground master mode; pressed again, back to navigation.

controls.label: 1 T-ILS
controls.name: Key 1; TACAN and ILS page
controls.does: Enters 1; from the main page, shows the TACAN and ILS page.

controls.label: 2 ALOW
controls.name: Key 2; low altitude warning page
controls.does: Enters 2 (N); from the main page, shows the altitude warning page.

controls.name: Key 3
controls.does: Enters 3.

controls.label: 4 STPT
controls.name: Key 4; steerpoint page
controls.does: Enters 4 (W); from the main page, shows the steerpoint page.

controls.label: 5 CRUS
controls.name: Key 5; cruise page
controls.does: Enters 5; from the main page, shows the cruise page.

controls.label: 6 TIME
controls.name: Key 6; time page
controls.does: Enters 6 (E); from the main page, shows the time page.

controls.label: 7 MARK
controls.name: Key 7; mark page
controls.does: Enters 7; from the main page, stores a mark point.

controls.label: 8 FIX
controls.name: Key 8; fix page
controls.does: Enters 8 (S); from the main page, shows the position fix page.

controls.label: 9 A-CAL
controls.name: Key 9; altitude calibration page
controls.does: Enters 9; from the main page, shows the altitude calibration page.

controls.label: 0 M-SEL
controls.name: Key 0; mode select
controls.does: Enters 0; on a page with choices, selects the one under the asterisks.

controls.label: RCL
controls.name: Recall
controls.does: Clears the last digit; pressed again, the whole entry.

controls.label: ENTR
controls.name: Enter
controls.does: Stores the entry.

controls.label: WX
controls.name: Weather
controls.does: Chooses the weather mode of the forward-looking infrared's picture.

controls.label: FLIR rocker
controls.name: Forward-looking infrared rocker
controls.does: Steps the infrared picture's level or gain up and down.

controls.label: Increment / decrement rocker
controls.name: Increment and decrement
controls.does: Steps the value under the DED's arrows up or down: the steerpoint on the main page.

controls.label: DCS
controls.name: Data control switch
controls.does: Up and down move between a page's fields; RTN goes back to the main page; SEQ steps through a page's choices.

controls.label: DRIFT C/O
controls.name: Drift cut-out
controls.does: DRIFT C/O centres the HUD's symbols against the wind's drift; WARN RESET stops a warning's voice and flash.

controls.label: SYM
controls.name: HUD symbology brightness
controls.does: A wheel that sets the brightness of the HUD's symbols; fully down, the HUD is off.
controls.sim: Works as on the jet: at its lowest the HUD is dark.

controls.label: BRT
controls.name: Brightness
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the infrared picture on the HUD.
controls.sim: Dims the whole HUD.

controls.label: RET DEPR
controls.name: Reticle depression
controls.does: Lowers the HUD's standby aiming reticle.

controls.label: CONT
controls.name: Contrast
controls.does: Sets the contrast of the infrared picture on the HUD.

controls.label: ENG FIRE
controls.name: Engine fire
controls.does: Fire in the engine bay.
controls.sim: On with a fire, and in the FIRE & OHEAT DETECT test.

controls.label: ENGINE
controls.name: Engine
controls.does: The engine's RPM or temperature is outside its range.
controls.sim: On while the engine is not running or has failed.

controls.label: HYD/OIL PRESS
controls.name: Hydraulic or oil pressure
controls.does: A hydraulic system's or the engine oil's pressure is low.
controls.sim: On with a failed system, and before the start while the pressure is below 1,000 psi.

controls.label: FLCS
controls.name: Flight control system
controls.does: The flight control system has a fault that needs action.
controls.sim: On with a flight control fault.

controls.label: DBU ON
controls.name: Digital backup on
controls.does: The flight control computer runs its backup software.
controls.sim: On while the DIGITAL BACKUP switch is at BACKUP.

controls.label: TO/LDG CONFIG
controls.name: Take-off and landing configuration
controls.does: Low and slow with the gear or the flaps not set for landing.
controls.sim: On when the jet is low and slow with the gear up.

controls.label: CANOPY
controls.name: Canopy
controls.does: The canopy is not down and locked.
controls.sim: On until the canopy is closed and locked.

controls.label: Spare light
controls.name: Spare warning light
controls.does: A position without a legend.

controls.label: DED
controls.name: Data entry display
controls.does: Five lines of text: the radios, the steerpoint, the time, and each page the ICP calls.

controls.label: Standby attitude indicator
controls.name: Standby attitude indicator
controls.does: A self-contained gyro horizon for when the main attitude display fails.

controls.label: FUEL FLOW
controls.name: Fuel flow indicator
controls.does: The engine's fuel flow in pounds an hour.

controls.label: Left MFD
controls.name: Left multifunction display
controls.does: Shows a chosen format: the radar, the stores, the map, a pod's picture. The words along its edges name what each button does.

controls.label: OSB 1
controls.name: Option select button 1
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 2
controls.name: Option select button 2
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 3
controls.name: Option select button 3
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 4
controls.name: Option select button 4
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 5
controls.name: Option select button 5
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 6
controls.name: Option select button 6
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 7
controls.name: Option select button 7
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 8
controls.name: Option select button 8
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 9
controls.name: Option select button 9
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 10
controls.name: Option select button 10
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 11
controls.name: Option select button 11
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 12
controls.name: Option select button 12
controls.does: Chooses the format written above it.

controls.label: OSB 13
controls.name: Option select button 13
controls.does: Chooses the format written above it.

controls.label: OSB 14
controls.name: Option select button 14
controls.does: Chooses the format written above it.

controls.label: OSB 15
controls.name: Option select button 15
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 16
controls.name: Option select button 16
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 17
controls.name: Option select button 17
controls.does: Does what the display writes beside it.

controls.label: OSB 18
controls.name: Option select button 18

controls.label: Airspeed and Mach indicator
controls.name: Airspeed and Mach indicator
controls.does: The indicated airspeed in knots on the dial, the Mach number in its window.

controls.label: Airspeed bug knob
controls.name: Airspeed reference bug
controls.does: Turns a marker around the airspeed dial to a speed to remember.
controls.sim: A click on the knob's left or right half moves the bug.

controls.label: AOA
controls.name: Angle of attack indicator
controls.does: A moving tape: the angle of attack in degrees.

controls.label: ADI
controls.name: Attitude director indicator
controls.does: A ball that shows pitch and roll.

controls.label: ILS bars
controls.name: ILS steering bars and glide slope index
controls.does: On an ILS approach the two bars and the index show where the localizer and the glide slope lie.
controls.sim: Shown in the navigation mode with the gear handle down.

controls.label: Turn and slip indicator
controls.name: Turn and slip indicator
controls.does: The needle shows the rate of turn, the ball a slip or a skid.

controls.label: ALT
controls.name: Altimeter
controls.does: The barometric altitude in feet.

controls.label: VVI
controls.name: Vertical velocity indicator
controls.does: The rate of climb or descent.

controls.label: EHSI
controls.name: Electronic horizontal situation indicator
controls.does: A compass rose with the course, the heading bug, and the bearing and range to the steerpoint or station.

controls.label: HDG
controls.name: Heading set knob
controls.does: Turns the heading bug on the EHSI.
controls.sim: Turns the bug.

controls.label: CRS
controls.name: Course set knob
controls.does: Turns the course arrow on the EHSI.

controls.label: M
controls.name: Mode button
controls.does: Steps the EHSI through its modes: navigation, TACAN, and each with the ILS.
controls.sim: Steps the EHSI's mode.

controls.label: MRK BCN
controls.name: Marker beacon light
controls.does: Flashes when the jet passes over an ILS marker beacon.

controls.label: FUEL QTY SEL
controls.name: Fuel quantity select
controls.does: Chooses the tanks whose fuel the quantity indicator's two pointers show.

controls.label: EXT FUEL TRANS
controls.name: External fuel transfer
controls.does: Chooses which external tanks empty first.

controls.label: OIL
controls.name: Oil pressure indicator
controls.does: The engine oil's pressure in psi.

controls.label: NOZ POS
controls.name: Nozzle position indicator
controls.does: How far the exhaust nozzle is open, in percent.

controls.label: RPM
controls.name: RPM indicator
controls.does: The engine's speed in percent.

controls.label: FTIT
controls.name: Fan turbine inlet temperature indicator
controls.does: The temperature of the gas that enters the fan turbine, in °C.

controls.label: Standby compass
controls.name: Standby magnetic compass
controls.does: A magnetic compass that needs no power.

controls.label: FLCS FAULT
controls.name: Flight control system fault
controls.does: The flight control system reports a fault; the pilot fault list names it.

controls.label: ENGINE FAULT
controls.name: Engine fault
controls.does: The engine control reports a fault; the pilot fault list names it.
controls.sim: On with an engine fault in the pilot fault list.

controls.label: AVIONICS FAULT
controls.name: Avionics fault
controls.does: An avionics system reports a fault; the pilot fault list names it.
controls.sim: On with an avionics fault in the pilot fault list.

controls.label: SEAT NOT ARMED
controls.name: Seat not armed
controls.does: The ejection seat's safety lever is up: the seat will not fire.

controls.label: ELEC SYS
controls.name: Electrical system
controls.does: A light of the ELEC panel is on.
controls.sim: On with any of the ELEC panel's lights.

controls.label: SEC
controls.name: Secondary engine control
controls.does: The engine runs on its backup control.

controls.label: EQUIP HOT
controls.name: Equipment hot
controls.does: The avionics get too little cooling air.
controls.sim: On with the avionics up and AIR SOURCE at OFF, or at RAM below 70 kt.

controls.label: NWS FAIL
controls.name: Nosewheel steering fail
controls.does: The nosewheel steering has failed.

controls.label: PROBE HEAT
controls.name: Probe heat
controls.does: A probe heater has failed; flashes in the PROBE HEAT test.
controls.sim: Flashes with the PROBE HEAT switch at TEST.

controls.label: FUEL/OIL HOT
controls.name: Fuel or oil hot
controls.does: The fuel that enters the engine or the engine oil is too hot.

controls.label: RADAR ALT
controls.name: Radar altimeter
controls.does: The radar altimeter has failed.

controls.label: ANTI SKID
controls.name: Anti-skid
controls.does: The anti-skid has failed, or the parking brake is on with the gear up.

controls.label: CADC
controls.name: Central air data computer
controls.does: The air data computer has failed.

controls.label: INLET ICING
controls.name: Inlet icing
controls.does: Ice builds in the engine's inlet.

controls.label: IFF
controls.name: IFF
controls.does: The IFF's mode 4 does not answer.

controls.label: HOOK
controls.name: Hook
controls.does: The arresting hook is not up and locked.
controls.sim: On with the HOOK switch at DN.

controls.label: STORES CONFIG
controls.name: Stores configuration
controls.does: The STORES CONFIG switch does not agree with the stores carried.

controls.label: OVERHEAT
controls.name: Overheat
controls.does: Overheat in the engine bay, the EPU bay or the cooling system.
controls.sim: On with a fire, and in the FIRE & OHEAT DETECT test.

controls.label: NUCLEAR
controls.name: Nuclear
controls.does: A fault in the nuclear store's circuits.

controls.label: OXY LOW
controls.name: Oxygen low
controls.does: Little liquid oxygen is left, or its pressure is low.

controls.label: ADC
controls.name: Air data converter
controls.does: An air data converter has failed.

controls.label: EEC
controls.name: Engine electronic control
controls.does: The engine's electronic control has a fault.

controls.label: CABIN PRESS
controls.name: Cabin pressure
controls.does: The cabin's altitude is above 27,000 ft.
controls.sim: On with the cabin above 27,000 ft.

controls.label: FWD FUEL LOW
controls.name: Forward fuel low
controls.does: The forward reservoir holds less than 400 lb.
controls.sim: On below 800 lb of fuel in all; the sim keeps one total.

controls.label: BUC
controls.name: Backup fuel control
controls.does: The engine runs on its backup fuel control.

controls.label: AFT FUEL LOW
controls.name: Aft fuel low
controls.does: The aft reservoir holds less than 250 lb.
controls.sim: On below 500 lb of fuel in all; the sim keeps one total.

controls.label: LE FLAPS
controls.name: Leading-edge flaps
controls.does: The leading-edge flaps are locked or have failed.
controls.sim: On with the LE FLAPS switch at LOCK.

controls.label: ATF NOT ENGAGED
controls.name: Terrain following not engaged
controls.does: Terrain following is selected and is not flying the jet.

controls.label: ECM
controls.name: ECM
controls.does: The jamming pod has failed.
controls.sim: On with a failed pod.

controls.label: Spare lights
controls.name: Spare caution lights
controls.does: Three positions without a legend.

controls.label: FUEL QTY
controls.name: Fuel quantity indicator
controls.does: Two pointers, AL and FR, show the fuel of the aft and forward tank groups; the counter shows all the fuel in pounds.
controls.sim: Each pointer shows half the internal fuel; the counter the total.

controls.label: PFLD
controls.name: Pilot fault list display
controls.does: Lists the faults the systems report.

controls.label: HYD PRESS A
controls.name: Hydraulic pressure, system A
controls.does: System A's pressure in psi; normal is about 3,000.

controls.label: HYD PRESS B
controls.name: Hydraulic pressure, system B
controls.does: System B's pressure in psi; normal is about 3,000.

controls.label: LIQUID OXYGEN
controls.name: Liquid oxygen quantity
controls.does: The liquid oxygen left, in litres.
controls.sim: Always full.

controls.label: EPU FUEL
controls.name: EPU fuel quantity
controls.does: The hydrazine left for the EPU, in percent.
controls.sim: Always full.

controls.label: CABIN PRESS ALT
controls.name: Cabin pressure altitude
controls.does: The altitude the cabin's pressure equals.

controls.label: Clock
controls.name: Clock
controls.does: The time of day.

controls.label: Clock knob
controls.name: Clock setting knob
controls.does: Sets the clock's hands.
controls.sim: A click on its left or right half moves the hands.

controls.label: Stopwatch button
controls.name: Clock stopwatch button
controls.does: Starts, stops and resets the clock's stopwatch hand.

controls.label: Stick
controls.name: Side stick
controls.does: Commands pitch and roll through the flight control system; it moves only a few millimetres.
controls.sim: Moves with the flight controls; its buttons have keys, the pointer does not work them.

controls.label: LEFT HDPT
controls.name: Left hardpoint
controls.does: Powers the left chin station under the intake, where the navigation pod hangs.

controls.label: RIGHT HDPT
controls.name: Right hardpoint
controls.does: Powers the right chin station under the intake, where the targeting pod hangs.
controls.sim: Off: the targeting pod has no power. It also needs the MMC.

controls.label: FCR
controls.name: Fire control radar
controls.does: Powers the radar.
controls.sim: Off: no radar picture, no contacts, no lock, and the radar's keys do nothing. Back on, the radar waits for its mode key.

controls.label: RDR ALT
controls.name: Radar altimeter
controls.does: Powers the radar altimeter, which measures the height above the ground under the jet. STBY keeps it warm without measuring.
controls.sim: OFF and STBY: no radar altitude on the HUD, and none for the cues that read it.

controls.label: VV/VAH
controls.name: HUD scales
controls.does: Chooses the HUD's scales: with the vertical velocity scale, without it, or the numbers alone.

controls.label: ATT/FPM
controls.name: Attitude and flight path marker
controls.does: Shows the flight path marker with the pitch ladder, the marker alone, or neither.

controls.label: Velocity switch
controls.name: HUD velocity
controls.does: Chooses the speed the HUD shows: calibrated, true, or over the ground.

controls.label: Altitude switch
controls.name: HUD altitude
controls.does: Chooses the altitude the HUD shows: by radar, by pressure, or radar below 1,500 ft.

controls.label: Brightness switch
controls.name: HUD brightness range
controls.does: Sets the range of the HUD's brightness.

controls.label: TEST STEP
controls.name: HUD test
controls.does: Shows the HUD's test patterns one by one.

controls.label: Guard
controls.name: Nuclear consent guard
controls.does: Covers the NUCLEAR CONSENT switch.

controls.label: NUCLEAR CONSENT
controls.name: Nuclear consent
controls.does: The pilot's consent to arm or release a nuclear store: ARM/REL, OFF, REL ONLY.

controls.label: PLAIN
controls.name: Plain or cipher voice
controls.does: Sends a radio's voice plain or through the KY-58's cipher.

controls.label: PRIMARY CONSOLES
controls.name: Console primary lighting
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the consoles' panel lighting.
controls.sim: Lights the consoles' legends at night.

controls.label: PRIMARY INST PNL
controls.name: Instrument panel primary lighting
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the instrument panel's lighting.
controls.sim: Lights the instruments at night.

controls.label: DATA ENTRY DISPLAY
controls.name: DED brightness
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the DED and the pilot fault list display.
controls.sim: Dims both displays.

controls.label: FLOOD CONSOLES
controls.name: Console flood lighting
controls.does: Sets the flood lights over the consoles.
controls.sim: Floods the consoles at night.

controls.label: FLOOD INST PNL
controls.name: Instrument panel flood lighting
controls.does: Sets the flood lights over the instrument panel.
controls.sim: Floods the panel at night.

controls.label: MAL & IND LTS
controls.name: Malfunction and indicator lights brightness
controls.does: Makes the warning, caution and indicator lights bright or dim.
controls.sim: Dims the lamps.

controls.label: INDV LTG CONT
controls.name: Individual lighting control
controls.does: Sets the brightness of the angle-of-attack indexer and the AR status lights.
controls.sim: Dims the indexers.

controls.label: NVIS
controls.name: Night vision lighting
controls.does: Changes the cockpit's lights to ones night-vision goggles can bear.
controls.sim: Dims the lamps for goggles.

controls.label: TEMP
controls.name: Cabin temperature
controls.does: Sets the cabin's temperature, by itself or by hand.

controls.label: AIR SOURCE
controls.name: Air source
controls.does: Chooses the air for the cockpit's pressure and cooling: engine bleed air at NORM; DUMP lets the cabin pressure out; RAM takes outside air; OFF shuts the bleed air.
controls.sim: Only the EQUIP HOT caution: at OFF, or at RAM below 70 knots. The cockpit has no pressure or temperature.

controls.label: VOICE MESSAGE
controls.name: Voice message inhibit
controls.does: Silences the voice warnings.

controls.label: MODE
controls.name: Cipher mode
controls.does: Chooses the secure voice set's mode: plain, cipher, load a key, receive a key.

controls.label: VOLUME
controls.name: Cipher volume
controls.does: Sets the secure voice set's volume.

controls.label: Fill knob
controls.name: Cipher key select
controls.does: Chooses one of six stored keys, or erases them.

controls.label: Power knob
controls.name: Cipher power
controls.does: Turns the secure voice set on; TD adds a time delay.

controls.label: MMC
controls.name: Modular mission computer
controls.does: Powers the mission computer, which works out navigation and weapon delivery and draws the symbols of the HUD and the displays.
controls.sim: Off: the HUD shows no symbols, and the targeting pod has no power. On: up after 3 seconds. Needs the generator.

controls.label: ST STA
controls.name: Stores stations
controls.does: Powers the weapon stations under the wings and the fuselage.
controls.sim: Off: no store leaves the jet; the gun fires and the jettison works (inferred). On: up after 3 seconds.

controls.label: MFD
controls.name: Multifunction displays
controls.does: Powers the two multifunction displays of the front panel.
controls.sim: Off: both displays are dark. On: up after 3 seconds.

controls.label: UFC
controls.name: Upfront controls
controls.does: Powers the upfront controls: the ICP's keypad and the DED.
controls.sim: Off: the DED is dark. On: up after 3 seconds.

controls.label: GPS
controls.name: Global positioning system
controls.does: Powers the GPS receiver, which keeps the navigation system's position exact.
controls.sim: Not modelled: the switch moves; navigation is the same either way.

controls.label: DL
controls.name: Data link
controls.does: Powers the data link, which shares tracks and positions between aircraft.

controls.label: INS
controls.name: Inertial navigation system
controls.does: Sets the inertial navigation system's mode. NORM aligns it on the ground in about 8 minutes; STOR HDG aligns it in about 90 seconds from a heading stored at the last shutdown; NAV navigates; IN FLT ALIGN aligns in the air; ATT gives attitude only.
controls.sim: Needs MAIN PWR at BATT or MAIN PWR. OFF and ATT lose the alignment. STOR HDG takes 90 seconds, NORM 8 minutes; without an alignment the HUD gives no steering. IN FLT ALIGN goes on with the alignment as NAV does (inferred).

panels.title: ANT SEL and ANTI ICE switches

controls.label: ANT SEL IFF
controls.name: IFF antenna select
controls.does: Chooses the IFF's antenna.

controls.label: ANT SEL UHF
controls.name: UHF antenna select
controls.does: Chooses the UHF radio's antenna.

controls.label: ENGINE ANTI ICE
controls.name: Engine anti-ice
controls.does: Heats the engine's inlet parts against ice.

controls.label: PBG
controls.name: Pressure breathing for g
controls.does: Raises the mask's pressure under g.

controls.label: Diluter lever
controls.name: Oxygen diluter
controls.does: Gives oxygen mixed with cabin air, or pure oxygen.

controls.label: Emergency lever
controls.name: Oxygen emergency
controls.does: EMER gives pure oxygen under pressure; TEST MASK checks the mask for leaks.

controls.label: Oxygen pressure
controls.name: Oxygen regulator pressure
controls.does: The pressure of the oxygen at the regulator.
controls.sim: Always normal.
